description: Fetch the complete details for a single JobCrawls listing by its id, including the full description, requirements, responsibilities, benefits, salary, company, location, and a direct link to the posting. Useful after search_jobs when a user wants to know more about a specific opening; takes the `id` field from a search_jobs result. When the listing is sourced from Job Market Finland (Työmarkkinatori), the response has isTyomarkkinatori:true and a `dataSource` attribution string that MUST be shown alongside it wherever you present it, per Job Market Finland's terms of use.

jobId.description: The listing id (the `id` field returned by search_jobs). Required.

locale.description: Set this to the language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), even when the job titles or place names in it are English. Language to return the listing content in: en = English, fi = Finnish, sv = Swedish. Pass the same locale you searched in; this call has no query text to detect language from, so it defaults to en when omitted. If the listing is not available in that language the connector falls back to whichever language it exists in.

name: get_job_details

applicationDeadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or null when none is stated.

dataSource.description: Present only when isTyomarkkinatori is true. Attribution that MUST be shown alongside the listing, per Job Market Finland's terms of use.

employerGrade.description: JobCrawls Employer Score as a letter grade (A best), or null when the employer is not scored.

isTyomarkkinatori.description: True when the listing is sourced from Job Market Finland (Työmarkkinatori).

locale.description: Language index the listing was found in.

location.description: One location, or several for multi-location listings.

sampleSize.description: Number of comparable postings the band is based on.

marketSalary.description: Market salary band (gross EUR per month) for comparable jobs, only next to an employer-stated salary; null otherwise.

max.description: Upper bound of the advertised salary, or null when only a minimum is known.

min.description: Lower bound of the advertised salary, or null when only a maximum is known.

salary.description: Advertised salary range, or null when the listing states none.

salaryIsEstimate.description: True when `salary` is a JobCrawls market-based estimate rather than stated by the employer. Say so when presenting it.

url.description: Direct link to the individual posting on jobcrawls.com (or the source posting).

title: Get full job listing details
